sources.snippet: Model Description This is a CoreML conversion of NVIDIA's Parakeet TDT 0.6B Japanese model, a state-of-the-art automatic speech recognition (ASR) model based on the FastConformer-TDT (Token-and-Duration Transducer) architecture.
